solutionSql:
SELECT s.customer_id, i.id,
       ROUND(i.amount / SUM(i.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY s.customer_id), 4) AS share
FROM invoices i
JOIN shipments s ON s.id = i.shipment_id
ORDER BY s.customer_id, i.id;

ambiguities.phrase: its share of its customer’s total billed amount
ambiguities.readingChosen: Invoice amount divided by the sum of all that customer’s invoices, with a plain division.
ambiguities.alternativeReading: A customer total of zero (allowed by the amount >= 0 check) makes the division fail. The ticket does not say whether the share should be NULL or 0.

notes: Smallest customer total on the sample is 6075.00, so the zero-total case cannot occur on the visible data. A scalar-subquery formulation agrees on all 205 rows.
